## Checklist

- [ ] I wrote this, or have the right to give it away under CC0. It has no real people's names, no customer data and no third-party text.
- [ ] I changed `templates/<id>/` and ran `node scripts/build.ts`, so `built/<id>.json` matches.
- [ ] Its `purpose` and `audience` are filled in, and its starter files are short and original.

The automatic check lists every web and email address in the template, and any line worth a careful read. A reviewer reads those before merging.
